services.name: Sailing Pass
services.desc: Bring your team together for a memorable experience on the water with Group & Corporate Sailing at Piers Park Sailing Center. Whether you’re planning a team-building day, client outing, celebration, or group activity, our sailing experiences offer a refreshing alternative to the usual off-site. With experienced crew, beautiful harbor views, and no sailing experience required, it’s an engaging, hands-on way to connect, unwind, and enjoy Boston Harbor. Ideal for corporate teams, nonprofits, schools, community groups, and private gatherings - no sailing experience needed and suitable for a wide range of ages and abilities. services.name: Kayak Pass
services.desc: Trade sidewalks for skyline views with our 2026 Kayak Pass, your ticket to exploring Boston Harbor. Glide through peaceful coves in one of our Solara kayaks and soak up sunset reflections off the city’s edge. Whether you’re chasing end-of-day light or carving out midday adventure, this pass unlocks the freedom to book seven days a week, skip the rental line and make the harbor your happy place. Kayak passes are available to anyone age 21+. You must be in relatively good physical shape and the maximum individual weight capacity for the kayak is 250lbs.
